Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）

C. I. D.
I. O. REQ
No 16
Date 15-1-16

January 15th 1916

Sir,
Previous to the first revolution the Chinese Tramway
Co had permission to lay rails as far as the Arsenal.
Owing to the military importance assumed by that institution
at the time mentioned, the permission was withdrawn, and
the rails which were to be used for that purpose were
left on the company's hands. The manager of the Company
is now reported to have obtained the sanction of the City
Authorities to lay a line from the Small East Gate to the
West Gate through the City in order to utilise these rails.
This project is not regarded with favour by many of the
City residents. At 3 p.m. 14th instant a meeting,
attended by seventy eight members of the City gentry
and merchants was held in the City temple with a view
to opposing the innovation. After speeches had been made
pointing out the disadvantages of the scheme from a
public point of view, the matter was put to a vote and
it was unanimously decided to oppose it. The meeting
was presided over by a silk merchant named Org Zung Zen 翁慎傳
The latter and five others were selected to wait on
the manager of the Tramway Co and request him to abandon
his scheme for the sake of public benefit.

Your Obedient Servant,

mmmmmmsting
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entered on M.S. Jan 16.
Seen by C.I.D.

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处（侦探股））

刑事侦缉处
情报官申请
第 16 号
日期 16-1-15

1916年1月15日

先生：

在第一次革命之前，华商电车公司曾获准铺设铁轨至兵工厂。鉴于该机构在当时所具有的军事重要性，该项许可被撤销，原拟用于此目的的铁轨仍留存在该公司手中。据报，该公司经理现已获得华界当局批准，计划从城中小东门经城内铺筑线路至西门，以利用这些铁轨。许多城内居民对该项目持反对态度。本月14日下午3时，七十八位城绅及商人在城隍庙举行会议，旨在反对这一革新举措。会上发言指出了该方案从公共利益角度看不利之处，随后对此事进行表决，一致决定予以反对。会议由一位名为翁慎傳 (Org Zung Zen) 的丝绸商人主持。后者及另外五人被推选去拜会电车公司经理，请求他为了公共利益放弃其计划。

您顺从的仆人，

mmmmmmsting
总探长。

警察总监。

于1月16日录入警务处档案。
刑事侦缉处阅。
